findings.source: DeltaSwapLibrary.sol:84-89 while(true) { fee = _fee; amountIn = getAmountIn(amounts[i], reserveIn, reserveOut, fee); _fee = calcPairTradingFee(amountIn, ...); if(_fee == fee) break; }; getAmountIn: numerator / ((reserveOut - amountOut) * (1000 - fee)) + 1; DSMath.calcTradeLiquidity -> DSMath.sqrt
findings.issue: amountIn is never bound to a name: its expanded formula (with '(reserveOut - amountOut) * (1000 - fee)' distributed into four products) is repeated up to eight times in single lines of the inlined calcTradeLiquidity and in the sqrt loop's header and body, so the fee fixed-point loop and the Babylonian sqrt are hard to recognise.
findings.rule: Bind a pure subexpression used more than once to a variable at its first use (amountIn, the sqrt argument), and keep products of differences factored ((a - b) * (c - d) rather than its four-term expansion).

notes: All 24 functions reviewed; the swaps (300-450 lines) by structure, the rest line by line. The 6 source loops are whiles: DeltaSwapLibrary.getAmountsOut (5 copies), getAmountsIn ('loop1: while idx', 4 copies) with its inner fee loop ('while True' exiting by 'continue loop1', 4 copies), Router01._swap (6 copies), Router02._swapSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens (3 copies, one as 'while True'), and DSMath.sqrt inside calcTradeLiquidity (10 copies). The 24 other whiles are implicit: TransferHelper calldata copies ('idx < 100'), return encodings of amounts, and 4 empty copy loops of new bytes(0) (P7). No semantic error found; 88 Error(string) reverts of the library checks stay 'revert with memory' (P2 family) although their messages are visible as hex words.
summary: Faithful with every loop present, but the fee-iteration and sqrt arithmetic is unreadable because amountIn is never named and its formula is distributed and repeated many times per line; the ETH paths are mostly dead because WETH and factory read as 0.
